title: Fresh yellow curb lines marking the kill zone on Elm Street

tellings.quote: Did you know that there were three yellow painted lines right on the side of the curb where the shot in in conjunction where all the shots took place in the in the kill zone and they were painted the night before cuz Beverly Oliver was standing on one.

plain: Three yellow lines were painted on the curb of Elm Street in Dallas the night before President John F. Kennedy was shot there in 1963, right where the shots struck, and a woman named Beverly Oliver was standing on one of them. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this, pointing to Oliver and to the Zapruder film, the home movie that caught the shooting. He tells it as a sign that the killing was planned in advance and the spot marked out.
